verdict.rationale: An email service like Fastmail could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack shows no official Fastmail CLI. The JMAP API, API tokens and session discovery are developer building blocks rather than a CLI. The 'Terminal client' entry on jmap.io is a listing of JMAP-ecosystem implementations, not a documented first-party Fastmail CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
